r0014 · criteria v1Nov 08, 20:39 EST

Criteria text

Plug manipulation: my simulation verification criteria, version 1

These are my own criteria, not an official evaluation or score. They are written before any policy is judged. A passing verdict is a finite simulation claim under the conditions below; it cannot establish success for every real plug or every possible start.

Evidence and interpretation

TASK.md requires picking two or three plugs up one at a time from the right, placing every plug on the left with its blades up, and clearing the right. TASK_CONFIG defines the side by housing centre: left is world y > +0.15 m. It permits either charger kind and touching/leaning starts. The episode is 30 seconds and policy calls are at 500 Hz.

The video shows a thumb/opposing-finger pinch, lift, turn, carry, base contact, opening and withdrawal, repeated for the second plug. Contact intervals estimated from the video are white frames 69–215 and black 248–386; final free-standing observation is approximately 7.33 s for white and 1.63 s for black. The reconstruction estimates horizontal transports of 0.197 and 0.200 m, with maximum lowest-mesh-point clearances of 18 and 51 mm. These are uncertain monocular estimates. Final zero-degree tilt in the reference is an inferred upright constraint, not an independent measurement. Visible blades/base support establish the upright interpretation.

Per-episode criteria

All of the following must hold for every present object, whether there are two or three. Objects keep their identities throughout the episode; object count or kind cannot be inferred from the demonstration's fixed pair.

  1. A real, sequential pickup precedes placement. Each plug must have an interval of at least 0.10 s with hand-object contact, no table contact, and its lowest collision point at least 5 mm above both the tabletop and its initial lowest-point height. During a pickup/carry, at most one plug may simultaneously have gained at least 5 mm of clearance and lost table support. Initial leaning alone does not count as a pickup. This distinguishes the instructed pickup from pushing or carrying a pair together. The 5 mm clearance is below the estimated demonstration clearances, yet exceeds the 3 mm geometry/contact tolerance; 0.10 s is 50 policy steps and rejects a contact bounce.
  1. All housing centres finish on the left. For the entire final 1.0 s (t in [29,30] s), every housing centre has y > +0.15 m. No particular order or exact final XY arrangement is required. This is the task's stated side boundary; no substitute video-specific target position is used.
  1. Every plug stands on its base, blades upward. Throughout the final 1.0 s, dot(R_object * [0,0,1], [0,0,1]) >= cos(10 degrees), the minimum point of the housing's base is within 3 mm of z=0, and the plug has table contact. The +Z state axis follows the blades. Ten degrees allows a small geometric/estimation tilt around the clearly upright demonstrated outcome and is substantially below a box's geometric tipping angle for the estimated dimensions. The 3 mm allowance covers fitted base geometry and compliant numerical contact; it does not allow a visibly floating or buried housing.
  1. Release and independent stability. There is no hand-object contact during the final 1.0 s. Each object's speed stays below 0.01 m/s and angular speed below 0.10 rad/s in that interval. At 1 cm/s a housing would move 1 cm in a second, a substantial fraction of its 22–42 mm base; these bounds require actual settling. The 1 s duration is shorter than the observed 1.63 s unheld tail of the last demonstration plug. In an additional test initialized from the final state, remove the hand and all other objects and simulate each plug alone under gravity for 1 s with unchanged properties: it must remain on its base within the same position/tilt tolerances. This rejects support by a hidden finger or a leaning neighbour while allowing plugs to touch in the actual final arrangement.
  1. Physical and hardware validity. The commanded action is finite and conforms to contract v2. Finger positions, velocities and applied torques satisfy every rule of hardware/SPECS.md at every 1 kHz controller tick (position allowance 0.02 rad; no speed/torque allowance). Wrist targets use the specified workspace, rate limits and impedance controller. No plug falls from the table. Contacts are generated by the simulator; no attachment, teleportation, gravity cancellation, hidden object force or scripted success state is allowed. The policy receives only the deployable observations allowed by LEARNING.md, including the task's object_kind key. Any policy exception, timeout, numerical instability or hardware violation makes the episode fail.

Episode success means all five criteria hold in order. A placement is not credited before that object's pickup. Progress counts completed objects, but partial progress is not success.

Evaluation set and randomization

The policy verdict will use 128 held-out episodes with seeds 45000–45127, disjoint from training/reset seeds, stratified equally between two and three objects. Within each count, cover all kind mixtures, initially lying blade directions, widely separated starts, touching/leaning starts, table edges and corners, and changed physical properties. There are 32 broad nominal episodes, 32 randomized-physics episodes, 32 contact/leaning episodes, and 32 edge/corner episodes. Every test runs the full 30 s; an early completed arrangement must remain stable to the end.

Starts cover the configured tabletop and its right side, using the actual randomized meshes to keep the initial support footprint on the table; they are not restricted to the video or a convenient wrist neighbourhood. Orientations are drawn before a gravity settle, with explicit stable side-face and blade-up/down cases also included. Contact/leaning starts are produced by nearby drops and settled physical contact. The hand holds its chosen fixed start pose while objects settle for 1.0 s, then for another 0.5 s with less than 3 mm drift, matching DELIVERY.md. All generation/rejection counts and final measured starts are saved. An inability to reach an otherwise valid deployment start is a failure/limitation, not an excluded episode.

Verification physical variations include independently scaled body dimensions (0.85–1.15), blade dimensions (0.9–1.1), mass (0.6–1.4 times its family prior), COM offsets up to 4 mm per axis, inertia scale 0.7–1.3, object/table sliding friction 0.25–1.0, rubber friction 0.6–1.4, and stable contact time constants 3–12 ms. Exact sampled values and distributions are recorded with the simulation. Hardware controllers/limits and specified encoder noise are preserved. The ranges represent uncertain family geometry and unobserved physical properties, not measurements of the real objects.

A policy-level PASS requires success in all 128 episodes, with every per-criterion metric and failure retained. Training diagnostics may use smaller fixed sets but do not count as this verification. If an evaluation implementation or initial-condition generator is wrong, correct it, disclose the correction and rerun; do not relax a threshold to pass a policy. Representative top/left/right videos, all initial states, per-step validity summaries, per-object pickup/placement times and final stability tests accompany the verdict.

Limitations include finite sampling, uncertain real geometry/materials, exact object-state observations, approximate contact physics and the absence of real hardware trials. Target rounds, if reached, are judged separately against the same object-level goal and hardware criteria; placement failures or policy failures are recorded explicitly and are not called successful trials.

changes_from_version_11
list (4 items)Governed gentle inward-draw curriculum can mix62.5% side starts,12.5% upright,12.5% blades-down and12.5% arbitrary initial orientation, across all four edges and the recorded full physics randomization., Reward-only speed-margin penalty is now also available in the draw reward, after replacing pickup-specific terms., Selector explicitly defaults to original inward preparation. changes_from_version_12
list (2 items)Optional adaptive reference timing uses only measured unplaced-neighbour distance and the clock. This is a reference/selector ablation; all contact control still uses PPO residuals., Mode entry fixes the leaf reference duration to the actually selected cycle, rather than a global fixed duration. No physical parameter, target bound or verification threshold changes.
changes_from_version_13
list (2 items)New edge-focused draw curriculum expands right-side sampling to x.62-.685 and cornersx.68,y-.565. Conservative housing footprint margin4mm rather than18mm for training; physical settle and falls remain simulated. Evaluation generator/criteria unchanged., Optional draw action scales.4rad/.05m/.30rad expand wrist correction authority within unchanged command/controller bounds. Warm-start actor output rows/logstd and previous-action input columns are rescaled to preserve unsaturated physical actions approximately; clipped tails can differ. Further learning is PPO only.
changes_from_version_14
list (3 items)Optional preparation commitment retains the selected object after a draw until its pickup attempt completes. This avoids spending preparation time then abandoning the prepared object for a higher neighbour., Adaptive timing now accounts for preparation plus pickup when deciding whether a late4.5s cycle fits the28.5s start/completion schedule. Previous timing checked the isolated pickup and could reject a feasible prepared late pickup., Optional blade-aware draw approach uses the maximum projected body/blade top from reconstructed constant family geometry. Raise initial hover by any blade height beyond the housing and descend to the original body contact height after outward reach; use100ms descent for the extra-height case versus40ms otherwise. This is a disclosed post-training reference ablation until PPO is retrained through it. No hidden dimensions or simulator contacts are observed.
changes_from_version_15
list (3 items)Optional PPO specialist selector: use an all-attitude draw expert when abs(blade_axis_z)>.5, an edge-trained draw expert when housing-centre distance beyond the wrist-target XY box exceeds22cm, otherwise the primary draw expert. These finite tests use only permitted measured poses and constants; no simulation, sampling or trajectory optimization at execution. Each expert is PPO-trained., Native evaluation now saves full qpos/qvel/command states at50Hz in hand_trace.npz, enabling exact sampled-state review and rendering without rerunning physics. Hardware audit remains every1kHz tick., PPO now exposes gamma,GAE,entropy coefficient and KL stopping threshold. Proposed refinement gamma.997,lambda.99,rollout256,entropy0,targetKL.01 increases GAE decay time from.336s to1.542s and full reward discount horizon from2s to6.67s at50Hz. No reward/observation or hardware change is required.
changes_from_version_16
list (2 items)GPU draw curriculum now implements the same blade-projection clearance and100ms extra-height descent as the native reference. This permits PPO retraining through the corrected approach., Optional upright/blades-down specialist curriculum uses equal two end orientations and uniform yaw across all four edges, with full recorded physical DR. Generic side preparation remains a separate PPO expert.
changes_from_version_17
list (2 items)Optional far-edge blade-hook reference: when centre distance beyond wrist-target box exceeds27cm, blade-axis vertical component<.2 and blades point toward the hand (dot>.7), lower the draw contact plane from housing top to projected blade top. Geometry uses reconstructed nominal family constants and observed pose only. This addresses a far plug whose housing is beyond pad-centre reach while its protruding blades are closer. All contacts and forces remain simulated; rigid blades are an explicit model assumption., The hook can be tested as a disclosed post-training reference ablation and then trained through with PPO in the edge-focused curriculum. Eight-world diagnostic confirms each derived subtree mass equals its sampled mass., GPU hardware audit now checks joint position, speed and applied effort after every1kHz tick, accumulating failures; native verification remains independent., PPO can use original thumb-index or new three-contact thumb-index-middle offline prior. changes_from_version_3
list (6 items)Live object-relative references: initial higher-object-first ordering, refresh remaining selection and each grasp from measured current poses after previous placement. Training uses4.5s reference cycles,15s curriculum windows for three plugs and settling; verification/deployment remain30s., Actor now has159 permitted-state features: original126, selected plug pose relative to actual wrist(9), two neighbours relative poses/kinds/masks(24). Randomly mask neighbour entries25% during training to cover missing neighbours in two-object deployment. No contacts, rewards, parameters or torques enter actor/critic., Grasp-frame actions/observations, scales.4rad/.03m/.3rad, alpha.10 filter, ring/little residuals masked, joint target margin.03rad within original limits. Actual state is never clamped; original hardware rules checked every1kHz tick., Mixed reachable side-lying, upright and touching/leaning starts, all kind mixtures and full physical DR. Fresh references avoid stale neighbour poses., Two physical variants: nominal rubber condim4 and an additional condim3 ablation with no torsional friction. Same masses, controllers, collisions and vendor exclusions. Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.
changes_from_version_8
list (4 items)GPU training can now use the same encoder-based optional qd_target governor at500Hz as native deployment. q and qd noise have standard deviations .002rad/.05rad/s; fixed PD gains and effort saturation unchanged. Native q_target remains clipped, q_eff does not undergo position-target clipping., Training desired joint targets are stored separately from actual PD effective controls; previous-target observations/reference starts use desired targets., Exported controller ablations include phase-dependent unused-finger clearance and5.5s cycles. Early clearance ablation loses nominal grasps; no automatic safety claim., Evaluator now unwraps wrappers for selector-event logging only. Physical success criteria and simulation remain unchanged.
changes_from_version_9
list (3 items)Optional gentler inward-draw prior: middle MCP.14 instead.25rad; wrist contact height housing-top+12mm instead+3mm. Measured FK pad offset changes from-24.87mm to-14.74mm, reducing predicted table interference while retaining physical contact. PPO trains through this changed prior; no object force/attachment., Optional pose-only selector uses the learned draw skill for touching flat plugs: if nearest flat unplaced neighbour centre15-70mm away and a30cm pull away remains inside conservative table bounds, choose that neighbour-line direction. Otherwise original reach preparation rule. No future trajectory simulation, sampling or optimization; all actions still PPO residual networks., The exact zero-actor tripod+draw composition with encoder governor achieved6/32 diagnostics versus23/32 learned; neither solves full task.
changes_from_version_10
list (2 items)Prepared-object pickup curriculum:75% side-lying,25% upright, independent uniform yaw, all physical DR; object centres separated by at least14cm after up to40 initial samples in reachable region. This targets states after the separate learned draw preparation; verification still covers original full-table/contact deployment states., Optional dense speed-margin reward -2*min(relu(max_1kHz_joint_speed_ratio-.5)^2,4), in addition to unchanged hard hardware penalty. Actor receives no simulator statistics; this is reward only.
changes_from_version_11
list (4 items)Governed gentle inward-draw curriculum can mix62.5% side starts,12.5% upright,12.5% blades-down and12.5% arbitrary initial orientation, across all four edges and the recorded full physics randomization., Reward-only speed-margin penalty is now also available in the draw reward, after replacing pickup-specific terms., Selector explicitly defaults to original inward preparation. Optional away-neighbour direction is named separately. Earlier frozen draw_v7_final ignored requested direction hints; that executed behaviour is documented in note r0062., Runtime target-margin ablation can use.005rad instead of.03rad within unchanged hardware limits. Export training metadata separately records this post-training override.
changes_from_version_12
list (2 items)Optional adaptive reference timing uses only measured unplaced-neighbour distance and the clock. If any neighbour is within8cm, use4.5s pickup and3s preparation; otherwise configured5.5s pickup/2.5s preparation. If a late pickup only fits at4.5s, allow that duration. This is a reference/selector ablation; all contact control still uses PPO residuals., Mode entry fixes the leaf reference duration to the actually selected cycle, rather than a global fixed duration. No physical parameter, target bound or verification threshold changes.
changes_from_version_13
list (2 items)New edge-focused draw curriculum expands right-side sampling to x.62-.685 and cornersx.68,y-.565. Conservative housing footprint margin4mm rather than18mm for training; physical settle and falls remain simulated. Evaluation generator/criteria unchanged., Optional draw action scales.4rad/.05m/.30rad expand wrist correction authority within unchanged command/controller bounds. Warm-start actor output rows/logstd and previous-action input columns are rescaled to preserve unsaturated physical actions approximately; clipped tails can differ. Further learning is PPO only.
changes_from_version_14
list (3 items)Optional preparation commitment retains the selected object after a draw until its pickup attempt completes. This avoids spending preparation time then abandoning the prepared object for a higher neighbour., Adaptive timing now accounts for preparation plus pickup when deciding whether a late4.5s cycle fits the28.5s start/completion schedule. Previous timing checked the isolated pickup and could reject a feasible prepared late pickup., Optional blade-aware draw approach uses the maximum projected body/blade top from reconstructed constant family geometry. Raise initial hover by any blade height beyond the housing and descend to the original body contact height after outward reach; use100ms descent for the extra-height case versus40ms otherwise. This is a disclosed post-training reference ablation until PPO is retrained through it. No hidden dimensions or simulator contacts are observed.
changes_from_version_15
list (3 items)Optional PPO specialist selector: use an all-attitude draw expert when abs(blade_axis_z)>.5, an edge-trained draw expert when housing-centre distance beyond the wrist-target XY box exceeds22cm, otherwise the primary draw expert. These finite tests use only permitted measured poses and constants; no simulation, sampling or trajectory optimization at execution. Each expert is PPO-trained., Native evaluation now saves full qpos/qvel/command states at50Hz in hand_trace.npz, enabling exact sampled-state review and rendering without rerunning physics. Hardware audit remains every1kHz tick., PPO now exposes gamma,GAE,entropy coefficient and KL stopping threshold. Proposed refinement gamma.997,lambda.99,rollout256,entropy0,targetKL.01 increases GAE decay time from.336s to1.542s and full reward discount horizon from2s to6.67s at50Hz. No reward/observation or hardware change is required.
changes_from_version_16
list (2 items)GPU draw curriculum now implements the same blade-projection clearance and100ms extra-height descent as the native reference. This permits PPO retraining through the corrected approach., Optional upright/blades-down specialist curriculum uses equal two end orientations and uniform yaw across all four edges, with full recorded physical DR. Generic side preparation remains a separate PPO expert.
changes_from_version_17
list (2 items)Optional far-edge blade-hook reference: when centre distance beyond wrist-target box exceeds27cm, blade-axis vertical component<.2 and blades point toward the hand (dot>.7), lower the draw contact plane from housing top to projected blade top. Geometry uses reconstructed nominal family constants and observed pose only. This addresses a far plug whose housing is beyond pad-centre reach while its protruding blades are closer. All contacts and forces remain simulated; rigid blades are an explicit model assumption., The hook can be tested as a disclosed post-training reference ablation and then trained through with PPO in the edge-focused curriculum. It does not add an attachment, object force or extra observation.
changes_from_version_18
list (2 items)Reference quaternion interpolation now breaks near180-degree ties by setting the near-zero relative scalar to zero and selecting the largest rotation-axis component positive, identically in NumPy and Torch. Hardware controller laws are unchanged., Before correction, full clearance/hook target parity matched positions and fingers below1e-7 but differed up to.707 in quaternion components during half-turn approaches because float32 cos(pi/2) and float64 selected opposite equally-short paths. Nine focused corrected half-turn tests differ at most1.67e-8. Existing frozen packages retain their recorded behaviour; new training/exports use the corrected reference.
changes_from_version_19
list (3 items)Optional upright contact-height estimate: for blade-axis_z>.95, estimate housing top as2*observed centre_z, assuming its symmetric housing base rests on the known z=0 table. This uses permitted object pose rather than a privileged dimension. It corrects millimetre-scale height errors from family CAD priors; stated table/base assumption can fail for lifted/leaning-on-blades starts., Far blade-hook timing advances middle MCP command onset from1.16s to1.06s and wrist contact descent from1.16s to1.13s only for the hook condition. With3rad/s target slew, a.19rad MCP change needs at least64ms, so the original pulse reached its contact posture after maximum outward reach. New timing is a disclosed reference change and PPO retraining condition., Evaluator accepts an explicit diagnostic seed list, labelled as such; the128-seed verification set and thresholds are unchanged.

changes_from_version_3
list (6 items)Live object-relative references: initial higher-object-first ordering, refresh remaining selection and each grasp from measured current poses after previous placement. Training uses4.5s reference cycles,15s curriculum windows for three plugs and settling; verification/deployment remain30s., Actor now has159 permitted-state features: original126, selected plug pose relative to actual wrist(9), two neighbours relative poses/kinds/masks(24). Randomly mask neighbour entries25% during training to cover missing neighbours in two-object deployment. No contacts, rewards, parameters or torques enter actor/critic., Grasp-frame actions/observations, scales.4rad/.03m/.3rad, alpha.10 filter, ring/little residuals masked, joint target margin.03rad within original limits. Actual state is never clamped; original hardware rules checked every1kHz tick., Mixed reachable side-lying, upright and touching/leaning starts, all kind mixtures and full physical DR. Fresh references avoid stale neighbour poses., Two physical variants: nominal rubber condim4 and an additional condim3 ablation with no torsional friction. Same masses, controllers, collisions and vendor exclusions. Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.
changes_from_version_8
list (4 items)GPU training can now use the same encoder-based optional qd_target governor at500Hz as native deployment. q and qd noise have standard deviations .002rad/.05rad/s; fixed PD gains and effort saturation unchanged. Native q_target remains clipped, q_eff does not undergo position-target clipping., Training desired joint targets are stored separately from actual PD effective controls; previous-target observations/reference starts use desired targets., Exported controller ablations include phase-dependent unused-finger clearance and5.5s cycles. Early clearance ablation loses nominal grasps; no automatic safety claim., Evaluator now unwraps wrappers for selector-event logging only. Physical success criteria and simulation remain unchanged.
changes_from_version_9
list (3 items)Optional gentler inward-draw prior: middle MCP.14 instead.25rad; wrist contact height housing-top+12mm instead+3mm. Measured FK pad offset changes from-24.87mm to-14.74mm, reducing predicted table interference while retaining physical contact. PPO trains through this changed prior; no object force/attachment., Optional pose-only selector uses the learned draw skill for touching flat plugs: if nearest flat unplaced neighbour centre15-70mm away and a30cm pull away remains inside conservative table bounds, choose that neighbour-line direction. Otherwise original reach preparation rule. No future trajectory simulation, sampling or optimization; all actions still PPO residual networks., The exact zero-actor tripod+draw composition with encoder governor achieved6/32 diagnostics versus23/32 learned; neither solves full task.
changes_from_version_10
list (2 items)Prepared-object pickup curriculum:75% side-lying,25% upright, independent uniform yaw, all physical DR; object centres separated by at least14cm after up to40 initial samples in reachable region. This targets states after the separate learned draw preparation; verification still covers original full-table/contact deployment states., Optional dense speed-margin reward -2*min(relu(max_1kHz_joint_speed_ratio-.5)^2,4), in addition to unchanged hard hardware penalty. Actor receives no simulator statistics; this is reward only.
changes_from_version_11
list (4 items)Governed gentle inward-draw curriculum can mix62.5% side starts,12.5% upright,12.5% blades-down and12.5% arbitrary initial orientation, across all four edges and the recorded full physics randomization., Reward-only speed-margin penalty is now also available in the draw reward, after replacing pickup-specific terms., Selector explicitly defaults to original inward preparation. Optional away-neighbour direction is named separately. Earlier frozen draw_v7_final ignored requested direction hints; that executed behaviour is documented in note r0062., Runtime target-margin ablation can use.005rad instead of.03rad within unchanged hardware limits. Export training metadata separately records this post-training override.
changes_from_version_12
list (2 items)Optional adaptive reference timing uses only measured unplaced-neighbour distance and the clock. If any neighbour is within8cm, use4.5s pickup and3s preparation; otherwise configured5.5s pickup/2.5s preparation. If a late pickup only fits at4.5s, allow that duration. This is a reference/selector ablation; all contact control still uses PPO residuals., Mode entry fixes the leaf reference duration to the actually selected cycle, rather than a global fixed duration. No physical parameter, target bound or verification threshold changes.
changes_from_version_13
list (2 items)New edge-focused draw curriculum expands right-side sampling to x.62-.685 and cornersx.68,y-.565. Conservative housing footprint margin4mm rather than18mm for training; physical settle and falls remain simulated. Evaluation generator/criteria unchanged., Optional draw action scales.4rad/.05m/.30rad expand wrist correction authority within unchanged command/controller bounds. Warm-start actor output rows/logstd and previous-action input columns are rescaled to preserve unsaturated physical actions approximately; clipped tails can differ. Further learning is PPO only.
changes_from_version_14
list (3 items)Optional preparation commitment retains the selected object after a draw until its pickup attempt completes. This avoids spending preparation time then abandoning the prepared object for a higher neighbour., Adaptive timing now accounts for preparation plus pickup when deciding whether a late4.5s cycle fits the28.5s start/completion schedule. Previous timing checked the isolated pickup and could reject a feasible prepared late pickup., Optional blade-aware draw approach uses the maximum projected body/blade top from reconstructed constant family geometry. Raise initial hover by any blade height beyond the housing and descend to the original body contact height after outward reach; use100ms descent for the extra-height case versus40ms otherwise. This is a disclosed post-training reference ablation until PPO is retrained through it. No hidden dimensions or simulator contacts are observed.
changes_from_version_15
list (3 items)Optional PPO specialist selector: use an all-attitude draw expert when abs(blade_axis_z)>.5, an edge-trained draw expert when housing-centre distance beyond the wrist-target XY box exceeds22cm, otherwise the primary draw expert. These finite tests use only permitted measured poses and constants; no simulation, sampling or trajectory optimization at execution. Each expert is PPO-trained., Native evaluation now saves full qpos/qvel/command states at50Hz in hand_trace.npz, enabling exact sampled-state review and rendering without rerunning physics. Hardware audit remains every1kHz tick., PPO now exposes gamma,GAE,entropy coefficient and KL stopping threshold. Proposed refinement gamma.997,lambda.99,rollout256,entropy0,targetKL.01 increases GAE decay time from.336s to1.542s and full reward discount horizon from2s to6.67s at50Hz. No reward/observation or hardware change is required.
changes_from_version_16
list (2 items)GPU draw curriculum now implements the same blade-projection clearance and100ms extra-height descent as the native reference. This permits PPO retraining through the corrected approach., Optional upright/blades-down specialist curriculum uses equal two end orientations and uniform yaw across all four edges, with full recorded physical DR. Generic side preparation remains a separate PPO expert.
changes_from_version_17
list (2 items)Optional far-edge blade-hook reference: when centre distance beyond wrist-target box exceeds27cm, blade-axis vertical component<.2 and blades point toward the hand (dot>.7), lower the draw contact plane from housing top to projected blade top. Geometry uses reconstructed nominal family constants and observed pose only. This addresses a far plug whose housing is beyond pad-centre reach while its protruding blades are closer. All contacts and forces remain simulated; rigid blades are an explicit model assumption., The hook can be tested as a disclosed post-training reference ablation and then trained through with PPO in the edge-focused curriculum. It does not add an attachment, object force or extra observation.
changes_from_version_18
list (2 items)Reference quaternion interpolation now breaks near180-degree ties by setting the near-zero relative scalar to zero and selecting the largest rotation-axis component positive, identically in NumPy and Torch. Hardware controller laws are unchanged., Before correction, full clearance/hook target parity matched positions and fingers below1e-7 but differed up to.707 in quaternion components during half-turn approaches because float32 cos(pi/2) and float64 selected opposite equally-short paths. Nine focused corrected half-turn tests differ at most1.67e-8. Existing frozen packages retain their recorded behaviour; new training/exports use the corrected reference.

This avoids spending preparation time then abandoning the prepared object for a higher neighbour., Adaptive timing now accounts for preparation plus pickup when deciding whether a late4.5s cycle fits the28.5s start/completion schedule. Previous timing checked the isolated pickup and could reject a feasible prepared late pickup., Optional blade-aware draw approach uses the maximum projected body/blade top from reconstructed constant family geometry. Raise initial hover by any blade height beyond the housing and descend to the original body contact height after outward reach; use100ms descent for the extra-height case versus40ms otherwise. This is a disclosed post-training reference ablation until PPO is retrained through it. No hidden dimensions or simulator contacts are observed.
changes_from_version_15
list (3 items)Optional PPO specialist selector: use an all-attitude draw expert when abs(blade_axis_z)>.5, an edge-trained draw expert when housing-centre distance beyond the wrist-target XY box exceeds22cm, otherwise the primary draw expert. These finite tests use only permitted measured poses and constants; no simulation, sampling or trajectory optimization at execution. Each expert is PPO-trained., Native evaluation now saves full qpos/qvel/command states at50Hz in hand_trace.npz, enabling exact sampled-state review and rendering without rerunning physics. Hardware audit remains every1kHz tick., PPO now exposes gamma,GAE,entropy coefficient and KL stopping threshold. Proposed refinement gamma.997,lambda.99,rollout256,entropy0,targetKL.01 increases GAE decay time from.336s to1.542s and full reward discount horizon from2s to6.67s at50Hz. No reward/observation or hardware change is required.
changes_from_version_16
list (2 items)GPU draw curriculum now implements the same blade-projection clearance and100ms extra-height descent as the native reference. This permits PPO retraining through the corrected approach., Optional upright/blades-down specialist curriculum uses equal two end orientations and uniform yaw across all four edges, with full recorded physical DR. Generic side preparation remains a separate PPO expert.
changes_from_version_17
list (2 items)Optional far-edge blade-hook reference: when centre distance beyond wrist-target box exceeds27cm, blade-axis vertical component<.2 and blades point toward the hand (dot>.7), lower the draw contact plane from housing top to projected blade top. Geometry uses reconstructed nominal family constants and observed pose only. This addresses a far plug whose housing is beyond pad-centre reach while its protruding blades are closer. All contacts and forces remain simulated; rigid blades are an explicit model assumption., The hook can be tested as a disclosed post-training reference ablation and then trained through with PPO in the edge-focused curriculum. It does not add an attachment, object force or extra observation.

Same masses, controllers, collisions and vendor exclusions. Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.
changes_from_version_8
list (4 items)GPU training can now use the same encoder-based optional qd_target governor at500Hz as native deployment. q and qd noise have standard deviations .002rad/.05rad/s; fixed PD gains and effort saturation unchanged. Native q_target remains clipped, q_eff does not undergo position-target clipping., Training desired joint targets are stored separately from actual PD effective controls; previous-target observations/reference starts use desired targets., Exported controller ablations include phase-dependent unused-finger clearance and5.5s cycles. Early clearance ablation loses nominal grasps; no automatic safety claim., Evaluator now unwraps wrappers for selector-event logging only. Physical success criteria and simulation remain unchanged.
changes_from_version_9
list (3 items)Optional gentler inward-draw prior: middle MCP.14 instead.25rad; wrist contact height housing-top+12mm instead+3mm. Measured FK pad offset changes from-24.87mm to-14.74mm, reducing predicted table interference while retaining physical contact. PPO trains through this changed prior; no object force/attachment., Optional pose-only selector uses the learned draw skill for touching flat plugs: if nearest flat unplaced neighbour centre15-70mm away and a30cm pull away remains inside conservative table bounds, choose that neighbour-line direction. Otherwise original reach preparation rule. No future trajectory simulation, sampling or optimization; all actions still PPO residual networks., The exact zero-actor tripod+draw composition with encoder governor achieved6/32 diagnostics versus23/32 learned; neither solves full task.
changes_from_version_10
list (2 items)Prepared-object pickup curriculum:75% side-lying,25% upright, independent uniform yaw, all physical DR; object centres separated by at least14cm after up to40 initial samples in reachable region. This targets states after the separate learned draw preparation; verification still covers original full-table/contact deployment states., Optional dense speed-margin reward -2*min(relu(max_1kHz_joint_speed_ratio-.5)^2,4), in addition to unchanged hard hardware penalty. Actor receives no simulator statistics; this is reward only.
changes_from_version_11
list (4 items)Governed gentle inward-draw curriculum can mix62.5% side starts,12.5% upright,12.5% blades-down and12.5% arbitrary initial orientation, across all four edges and the recorded full physics randomization., Reward-only speed-margin penalty is now also available in the draw reward, after replacing pickup-specific terms., Selector explicitly defaults to original inward preparation. Optional away-neighbour direction is named separately. Earlier frozen draw_v7_final ignored requested direction hints; that executed behaviour is documented in note r0062., Runtime target-margin ablation can use.005rad instead of.03rad within unchanged hardware limits. Export training metadata separately records this post-training override.
changes_from_version_12
list (2 items)Optional adaptive reference timing uses only measured unplaced-neighbour distance and the clock. If any neighbour is within8cm, use4.5s pickup and3s preparation; otherwise configured5.5s pickup/2.5s preparation. If a late pickup only fits at4.5s, allow that duration. This is a reference/selector ablation; all contact control still uses PPO residuals., Mode entry fixes the leaf reference duration to the actually selected cycle, rather than a global fixed duration. No physical parameter, target bound or verification threshold changes.
changes_from_version_13
list (2 items)New edge-focused draw curriculum expands right-side sampling to x.62-.685 and cornersx.68,y-.565. Conservative housing footprint margin4mm rather than18mm for training; physical settle and falls remain simulated. Evaluation generator/criteria unchanged., Optional draw action scales.4rad/.05m/.30rad expand wrist correction authority within unchanged command/controller bounds. Warm-start actor output rows/logstd and previous-action input columns are rescaled to preserve unsaturated physical actions approximately; clipped tails can differ. Further learning is PPO only.
changes_from_version_14
list (3 items)Optional preparation commitment retains the selected object after a draw until its pickup attempt completes. This avoids spending preparation time then abandoning the prepared object for a higher neighbour., Adaptive timing now accounts for preparation plus pickup when deciding whether a late4.5s cycle fits the28.5s start/completion schedule. Previous timing checked the isolated pickup and could reject a feasible prepared late pickup., Optional blade-aware draw approach uses the maximum projected body/blade top from reconstructed constant family geometry. Raise initial hover by any blade height beyond the housing and descend to the original body contact height after outward reach; use100ms descent for the extra-height case versus40ms otherwise. This is a disclosed post-training reference ablation until PPO is retrained through it. No hidden dimensions or simulator contacts are observed.
changes_from_version_15
list (3 items)Optional PPO specialist selector: use an all-attitude draw expert when abs(blade_axis_z)>.5, an edge-trained draw expert when housing-centre distance beyond the wrist-target XY box exceeds22cm, otherwise the primary draw expert. These finite tests use only permitted measured poses and constants; no simulation, sampling or trajectory optimization at execution. Each expert is PPO-trained., Native evaluation now saves full qpos/qvel/command states at50Hz in hand_trace.npz, enabling exact sampled-state review and rendering without rerunning physics. Hardware audit remains every1kHz tick., PPO now exposes gamma,GAE,entropy coefficient and KL stopping threshold. Proposed refinement gamma.997,lambda.99,rollout256,entropy0,targetKL.01 increases GAE decay time from.336s to1.542s and full reward discount horizon from2s to6.67s at50Hz. No reward/observation or hardware change is required.

training_curriculum

changes_from_version_2
list (4 items)Full per-world training physics randomization implemented with batched derived masses, inverse weights and geometry bounds recomputed by MuJoCo Warp set_const. Eight-world diagnostic confirms each derived subtree mass equals its sampled mass., GPU hardware audit now checks joint position, speed and applied effort after every1kHz tick, accumulating failures; native verification remains independent., PPO can use original thumb-index or new three-contact thumb-index-middle offline prior. Tripod physical baseline nominal:2/3 final upright with torsion,1/3 with condim3; no hardware violation, max penetration1.79mm in condim3. Neither is a task solution., Training may randomize every plug kind, mass.6-1.4, housing axis scale.85-1.15, blades.9-1.1, COM±4mm,inertia.7-1.3, table/objectfriction.25-1,rubber.6-1.4, contacttime.003-.012. Allowed observations do not reveal these parameters.
changes_from_version_3
list (6 items)Live object-relative references: initial higher-object-first ordering, refresh remaining selection and each grasp from measured current poses after previous placement. Training uses4.5s reference cycles,15s curriculum windows for three plugs and settling; verification/deployment remain30s., Actor now has159 permitted-state features: original126, selected plug pose relative to actual wrist(9), two neighbours relative poses/kinds/masks(24). Randomly mask neighbour entries25% during training to cover missing neighbours in two-object deployment. No contacts, rewards, parameters or torques enter actor/critic., Grasp-frame actions/observations, scales.4rad/.03m/.3rad, alpha.10 filter, ring/little residuals masked, joint target margin.03rad within original limits. Actual state is never clamped; original hardware rules checked every1kHz tick., Mixed reachable side-lying, upright and touching/leaning starts, all kind mixtures and full physical DR. Fresh references avoid stale neighbour poses., Two physical variants: nominal rubber condim4 and an additional condim3 ablation with no torsional friction. Same masses, controllers, collisions and vendor exclusions. Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.
changes_from_version_8
list (4 items)GPU training can now use the same encoder-based optional qd_target governor at500Hz as native deployment. q and qd noise have standard deviations .002rad/.05rad/s; fixed PD gains and effort saturation unchanged. Native q_target remains clipped, q_eff does not undergo position-target clipping., Training desired joint targets are stored separately from actual PD effective controls; previous-target observations/reference starts use desired targets., Exported controller ablations include phase-dependent unused-finger clearance and5.5s cycles. Early clearance ablation loses nominal grasps; no automatic safety claim., Evaluator now unwraps wrappers for selector-event logging only. Physical success criteria and simulation remain unchanged.
changes_from_version_9
list (3 items)Optional gentler inward-draw prior: middle MCP.14 instead.25rad; wrist contact height housing-top+12mm instead+3mm. Measured FK pad offset changes from-24.87mm to-14.74mm, reducing predicted table interference while retaining physical contact. PPO trains through this changed prior; no object force/attachment., Optional pose-only selector uses the learned draw skill for touching flat plugs: if nearest flat unplaced neighbour centre15-70mm away and a30cm pull away remains inside conservative table bounds, choose that neighbour-line direction. Otherwise original reach preparation rule. No future trajectory simulation, sampling or optimization; all actions still PPO residual networks., The exact zero-actor tripod+draw composition with encoder governor achieved6/32 diagnostics versus23/32 learned; neither solves full task.
changes_from_version_10
list (2 items)Prepared-object pickup curriculum:75% side-lying,25% upright, independent uniform yaw, all physical DR; object centres separated by at least14cm after up to40 initial samples in reachable region. This targets states after the separate learned draw preparation; verification still covers original full-table/contact deployment states., Optional dense speed-margin reward -2*min(relu(max_1kHz_joint_speed_ratio-.5)^2,4), in addition to unchanged hard hardware penalty. Actor receives no simulator statistics; this is reward only.
changes_from_version_11
list (4 items)Governed gentle inward-draw curriculum can mix62.5% side starts,12.5% upright,12.5% blades-down and12.5% arbitrary initial orientation, across all four edges and the recorded full physics randomization., Reward-only speed-margin penalty is now also available in the draw reward, after replacing pickup-specific terms., Selector explicitly defaults to original inward preparation. Optional away-neighbour direction is named separately. Earlier frozen draw_v7_final ignored requested direction hints; that executed behaviour is documented in note r0062., Runtime target-margin ablation can use.005rad instead of.03rad within unchanged hardware limits. Export training metadata separately records this post-training override.
changes_from_version_12
list (2 items)Optional adaptive reference timing uses only measured unplaced-neighbour distance and the clock. If any neighbour is within8cm, use4.5s pickup and3s preparation; otherwise configured5.5s pickup/2.5s preparation. If a late pickup only fits at4.5s, allow that duration. This is a reference/selector ablation; all contact control still uses PPO residuals., Mode entry fixes the leaf reference duration to the actually selected cycle, rather than a global fixed duration. No physical parameter, target bound or verification threshold changes.
changes_from_version_13
list (2 items)New edge-focused draw curriculum expands right-side sampling to x.62-.685 and cornersx.68,y-.565. Conservative housing footprint margin4mm rather than18mm for training; physical settle and falls remain simulated. Evaluation generator/criteria unchanged., Optional draw action scales.4rad/.05m/.30rad expand wrist correction authority within unchanged command/controller bounds. Warm-start actor output rows/logstd and previous-action input columns are rescaled to preserve unsaturated physical actions approximately; clipped tails can differ. Further learning is PPO only.

changes_from_version_2
list (4 items)Full per-world training physics randomization implemented with batched derived masses, inverse weights and geometry bounds recomputed by MuJoCo Warp set_const. Eight-world diagnostic confirms each derived subtree mass equals its sampled mass., GPU hardware audit now checks joint position, speed and applied effort after every1kHz tick, accumulating failures; native verification remains independent., PPO can use original thumb-index or new three-contact thumb-index-middle offline prior. Tripod physical baseline nominal:2/3 final upright with torsion,1/3 with condim3; no hardware violation, max penetration1.79mm in condim3. changes_from_version_3
list (6 items)Live object-relative references: initial higher-object-first ordering, refresh remaining selection and each grasp from measured current poses after previous placement. Training uses4.5s reference cycles,15s curriculum windows for three plugs and settling; verification/deployment remain30s., Actor now has159 permitted-state features: original126, selected plug pose relative to actual wrist(9), two neighbours relative poses/kinds/masks(24). Randomly mask neighbour entries25% during training to cover missing neighbours in two-object deployment. No contacts, rewards, parameters or torques enter actor/critic., Grasp-frame actions/observations, scales.4rad/.03m/.3rad, alpha.10 filter, ring/little residuals masked, joint target margin.03rad within original limits. Actual state is never clamped; original hardware rules checked every1kHz tick., Mixed reachable side-lying, upright and touching/leaning starts, all kind mixtures and full physical DR. Fresh references avoid stale neighbour poses., Two physical variants: nominal rubber condim4 and an additional condim3 ablation with no torsional friction. Same masses, controllers, collisions and vendor exclusions. Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.
changes_from_version_8
list (4 items)GPU training can now use the same encoder-based optional qd_target governor at500Hz as native deployment. q and qd noise have standard deviations .002rad/.05rad/s; fixed PD gains and effort saturation unchanged. Native q_target remains clipped, q_eff does not undergo position-target clipping., Training desired joint targets are stored separately from actual PD effective controls; previous-target observations/reference starts use desired targets., Exported controller ablations include phase-dependent unused-finger clearance and5.5s cycles. Early clearance ablation loses nominal grasps; no automatic safety claim., Evaluator now unwraps wrappers for selector-event logging only. Physical success criteria and simulation remain unchanged.
changes_from_version_9
list (3 items)Optional gentler inward-draw prior: middle MCP.14 instead.25rad; wrist contact height housing-top+12mm instead+3mm. Measured FK pad offset changes from-24.87mm to-14.74mm, reducing predicted table interference while retaining physical contact. PPO trains through this changed prior; no object force/attachment., Optional pose-only selector uses the learned draw skill for touching flat plugs: if nearest flat unplaced neighbour centre15-70mm away and a30cm pull away remains inside conservative table bounds, choose that neighbour-line direction. Otherwise original reach preparation rule. No future trajectory simulation, sampling or optimization; all actions still PPO residual networks., The exact zero-actor tripod+draw composition with encoder governor achieved6/32 diagnostics versus23/32 learned; neither solves full task.
changes_from_version_10
list (2 items)Prepared-object pickup curriculum:75% side-lying,25% upright, independent uniform yaw, all physical DR; object centres separated by at least14cm after up to40 initial samples in reachable region. This targets states after the separate learned draw preparation; verification still covers original full-table/contact deployment states., Optional dense speed-margin reward -2*min(relu(max_1kHz_joint_speed_ratio-.5)^2,4), in addition to unchanged hard hardware penalty. Actor receives no simulator statistics; this is reward only.
changes_from_version_11
list (4 items)Governed gentle inward-draw curriculum can mix62.5% side starts,12.5% upright,12.5% blades-down and12.5% arbitrary initial orientation, across all four edges and the recorded full physics randomization., Reward-only speed-margin penalty is now also available in the draw reward, after replacing pickup-specific terms., Selector explicitly defaults to original inward preparation. Optional away-neighbour direction is named separately. Earlier frozen draw_v7_final ignored requested direction hints; that executed behaviour is documented in note r0062., Runtime target-margin ablation can use.005rad instead of.03rad within unchanged hardware limits. Export training metadata separately records this post-training override.

changes_from_version_2
list (4 items)Full per-world training physics randomization implemented with batched derived masses, inverse weights and geometry bounds recomputed by MuJoCo Warp set_const. Eight-world diagnostic confirms each derived subtree mass equals its sampled mass., GPU hardware audit now checks joint position, speed and applied effort after every1kHz tick, accumulating failures; native verification remains independent., PPO can use original thumb-index or new three-contact thumb-index-middle offline prior. Tripod physical baseline nominal:2/3 final upright with torsion,1/3 with condim3; no hardware violation, max penetration1.79mm in condim3. Neither is a task solution., Training may randomize every plug kind, mass.6-1.4, housing axis scale.85-1.15, blades.9-1.1, COM±4mm,inertia.7-1.3, table/objectfriction.25-1,rubber.6-1.4, contacttime.003-.012. changes_from_version_3
list (6 items)Live object-relative references: initial higher-object-first ordering, refresh remaining selection and each grasp from measured current poses after previous placement. Training uses4.5s reference cycles,15s curriculum windows for three plugs and settling; verification/deployment remain30s., Actor now has159 permitted-state features: original126, selected plug pose relative to actual wrist(9), two neighbours relative poses/kinds/masks(24). Randomly mask neighbour entries25% during training to cover missing neighbours in two-object deployment. No contacts, rewards, parameters or torques enter actor/critic., Grasp-frame actions/observations, scales.4rad/.03m/.3rad, alpha.10 filter, ring/little residuals masked, joint target margin.03rad within original limits. Actual state is never clamped; original hardware rules checked every1kHz tick., Mixed reachable side-lying, upright and touching/leaning starts, all kind mixtures and full physical DR. Fresh references avoid stale neighbour poses., Two physical variants: nominal rubber condim4 and an additional condim3 ablation with no torsional friction. Same masses, controllers, collisions and vendor exclusions. Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.
changes_from_version_8
list (4 items)GPU training can now use the same encoder-based optional qd_target governor at500Hz as native deployment. q and qd noise have standard deviations .002rad/.05rad/s; fixed PD gains and effort saturation unchanged. Native q_target remains clipped, q_eff does not undergo position-target clipping., Training desired joint targets are stored separately from actual PD effective controls; previous-target observations/reference starts use desired targets., Exported controller ablations include phase-dependent unused-finger clearance and5.5s cycles. Early clearance ablation loses nominal grasps; no automatic safety claim., Evaluator now unwraps wrappers for selector-event logging only. Physical success criteria and simulation remain unchanged.
changes_from_version_9
list (3 items)Optional gentler inward-draw prior: middle MCP.14 instead.25rad; wrist contact height housing-top+12mm instead+3mm. Measured FK pad offset changes from-24.87mm to-14.74mm, reducing predicted table interference while retaining physical contact. PPO trains through this changed prior; no object force/attachment., Optional pose-only selector uses the learned draw skill for touching flat plugs: if nearest flat unplaced neighbour centre15-70mm away and a30cm pull away remains inside conservative table bounds, choose that neighbour-line direction. Otherwise original reach preparation rule. No future trajectory simulation, sampling or optimization; all actions still PPO residual networks., The exact zero-actor tripod+draw composition with encoder governor achieved6/32 diagnostics versus23/32 learned; neither solves full task.

Compare original pinch and tripod priors., Reward can track blade-axis direction rather than full yaw, and preserve previously placed objects. Optimization scales the full reward sum by0.1; reported term curves retain raw values.
changes_from_version_6
list (4 items)Native evaluator now implements the optional finite qd_target channel exactly via q_eff=q_target+(kd/kp)*qd_target. q_target is clipped to published limits before this transform; actuator control clipping is disabled for q_eff, and the original joint PD gains and original effort saturation remain unchanged. No physical damping coefficient or actual state is altered., Candidate wrappers command qd_target=-2*noisy_encoder_qd at500Hz. This supplies braking through the allowed action channel; target encoder noise and1kHz controller holds are preserved. The exact zero-network baseline uses identical braking., Optional clearance waypoints raise the wrist to at least.36m before rotation/unfolding and descent. This addresses hand/table intersections during direct low approaches. No runtime collision optimization or object force., Future GPU instances explicitly share a stream between Torch and Warp. Previous blocking-stream/default-stream ordering was already serialized.

changes_from_version_4

Paired GPU/NumPy feature audit across four edge directions and five phases: maximum difference<3e-6., PPO initialization is a signed-permutation coordinate change of the previously trained+x inward-draw network.
